records.c: Installs the road table pointers $2591 and $26D1, patches the colour source $27C1 and sets the script and scenery table pointers to $15CB and $16A3.
Fourteen glyphs copied by the stage prologue into $79CE–$79DB. The dashboard uses the installed short message.

Round 4 stores 97 traffic type values followed by $FF. The $A748 cursor advances when an object wraps forward and moves back when the opposite depth boundary is crossed. The prologue can use the first five entries to seed visible traffic.
Round 4 stores one swap selector per traffic spawn position. Zero leaves the sprite bank in place. The respawn loop passes a nonzero selector to $9B76.
21 little-endian behavior routine addresses. The stage doubles the object type, copies the selected word to $02/$03, and calls the engine dispatcher at $89FE.
The stage uses an even offset for the low byte of each traffic handler. The adjacent high-byte load uses this base plus the same even offset.

21 little-endian addresses of sprite composition tables. The projection code at $129A indexes by twice the traffic object type. Shared traffic and stage-specific vehicles can point to different tables.
The upper bytes of the projection-table pointers are read using this base and twice the type number. The paired low bytes are one address earlier.
The stage copies these 21 values into $A755 for the corresponding traffic objects. The projection assigns that value to each emitted sprite component at $A818.
Per-type flag loaded into $A767 before projection. When set, the projector may select an alternate shape list using the frame flash state.
Initial values copied into both $A76D and $A773 for the traffic type. The shot response decrements $A76D and uses the retained value when scoring.
